findings.finding: baseline-ui profile requirements empty understates MUST Tailwind, motion/react and cn; full-instruction conflict check prevents incorrect combination, but notes should expose these earlier.
Router does not guarantee unique or deterministic selection; realistic briefs can support multiple feasible choices, feedback comparison is semantic instruction.
One accountable source per aspect allows industrial direction + GSAP helpers while rejecting competing palette/motion mandates.
Missing or manual-only skills do not grant installation/invocation authority; explicit brand request overrides catalog aesthetics without changing component stack.
findings.evidence: router SKILL.md and catalog activation fields
